reason: My doctor said my magnesium could be low, so I want to try something real, and $24.99 for the first box is about 83 cents a day, which is fine for me. The named lab and the batch report make me feel okay about trying one box.
objection: Why only one form of magnesium when other brands put several forms in one capsule? And it is made in China, so I only trust it as far as that lab report goes.
would_change_my_mind: If the lab report on the page looked fake or did not match the batch number, or if I found a multi-form magnesium at a similar price per day with a coupon.
